aboutParagraphs: Hotel Elite Palazzo is a four-star hotel at Bank Junction on NH47 in Angamaly, Ernakulam, close to Cochin International Airport and Angamaly Railway Station. It is operated by the KSR Alankar Hotels & Resorts group and welcomes leisure travellers, business guests, pilgrims, and sightseers.

The hotel offers a restaurant and bar, a coffee shop, a banquet hall and conference facilities, 24-hour room service, free parking, Wi-Fi, a travel desk, and doctor-on-call service. That mix matters for social media, because guests here are not all booking the same thing. One person needs a room after a late flight, another is organising a family function, and a third is travelling on business. A hotel profile has to show each of them that the place fits.

This case study covers the Instagram and Facebook work delivered by Teknoppy: how the profiles are structured, what the content is built around, and how they support the hotel's wider online presence. It does not cover hotel operations, room tariffs, or guest services, which belong to Hotel Elite Palazzo.
challengeLead: Key challenges addressed during the social media engagement:

challenges.title: The best selling point had to be obvious
challenges.description: Being steps from the airport and the railway station is exactly what many travellers search for. It needed to be visible on the profile and in the content, not left for the guest to work out.

challenges.title: Several guest types, one profile
challenges.description: A transit traveller, a business guest, a pilgrim, and a family planning a function look for different things. The content had to speak to each without becoming a vague mix.

challenges.title: Facilities needed to be seen, not just listed
challenges.description: A banquet hall, restaurant, and conference facilities are strong draws, but a line of text does little. Guests respond to seeing the space.

challenges.title: Guests check several places before booking
challenges.description: People compare the hotel's Google listing, its Instagram, its Facebook page, and booking sites. If the details differ between them, trust drops.

challenges.title: Interest needed a clear way to become an enquiry
challenges.description: Whether someone wants a room or a banquet booking, the path from profile to phone call or reservation should be obvious.

objectiveLead: Teknoppy was engaged to plan and manage the hotel's Instagram and Facebook presence so that it helps guests find, trust, and contact Hotel Elite Palazzo. The brief centred on:
objectives: Putting the Cochin Airport and Angamaly Railway Station location up front
Creating content for business, leisure, pilgrim, and event guests
Showing rooms, dining, and banquet facilities as they really are
Keeping name, address, and contact details identical across Instagram, Facebook, Google, and the website
Giving every profile and post a clear route to reserve or enquire
approachLead: How Teknoppy built an experience-driven social media structure for a multi-audience hotel:

approachPillars.title: Location as the opening line
paragraphs: The hotel's position beside the airport and the railway station is stated plainly in the profile and returned to in content. A traveller arriving late or leaving early can see at once that the hotel suits that plan.

approachPillars.title: Content planned by guest type
paragraphs: Posts are grouped around who is booking: a convenient stay for travellers in transit, comfortable rooms and meeting facilities for business guests, and the banquet hall for families and event hosts. Each group sees something made for them.

approachPillars.title: Facilities shown in use
paragraphs: The restaurant, bar, coffee shop, banquet hall, and conference space are shown through real photos and short clips rather than only named in a list. Guests judge a venue by how it looks, so this is where social media does the work a text description cannot.

approachPillars.title: Instagram and Facebook doing different jobs
paragraphs: Instagram leads with visuals of the rooms, food, and spaces. Facebook suits fuller descriptions, event information, and the practical details that families and older guests often look for. Both carry the same hotel name and address.

approachPillars.title: Profiles aligned with the Google listing and website
paragraphs: The hotel's social profiles are kept in line with its Google Business Profile and website, using the same name, address, and contact details. That consistency helps guests trust what they see and helps search tools connect every profile to the same property.

approachPillars.title: A profile that leads to a booking
paragraphs: The profile gives a clear way to call or reserve, so a guest who decides in the moment is not left searching. The same applies to banquet enquiries, which need a different kind of conversation from a room booking.

deliverables.description: Consistent profiles with the hotel's name, address, and contact details on both platforms.

deliverables.title: A location-first profile
deliverables.description: The Cochin Airport and Angamaly Railway Station advantage stated clearly and reinforced in content.

deliverables.title: Guest-type content themes
deliverables.description: Content planned for travellers, business guests, pilgrims, and event hosts.

deliverables.title: Facility-led content
deliverables.description: Rooms, restaurant, banquet hall, and conference spaces shown through visuals.

deliverables.title: Aligned details across channels
deliverables.description: The same name, address, and contacts across Instagram, Facebook, Google, and the website.

deliverables.title: A clear enquiry route
deliverables.description: An obvious path from profile or post to reservations and banquet enquiries.

whyMattersParagraphs: Booking a hotel is a quick decision made with several tabs open. A guest looks at the Google listing, the Instagram page, the Facebook page, and a booking site, then picks the one that looks most reliable and easiest to reach. A hotel whose profiles agree with each other and answer the obvious questions earns that choice.

Consistency also helps in search. Search engines and AI answer tools draw on social profiles and business listings when they answer questions like which hotel is near Cochin Airport. When the hotel's name, location, and facilities are stated the same way everywhere, those tools can describe Hotel Elite Palazzo accurately.

Social media works best as part of a wider online presence alongside the website and Google listing. Posting with a plan, rather than only when there is news, keeps the hotel looking active and cared for.
